members.name: Aridity (P/PET)
members.source: CHIRPS v3 monthly precipitation and ERA5 2 m temperature (Thornthwaite PET)
members.method: Annual P / PET on the council polygon, 1991-2020 climatology (scripts/compute-aridity.py)

members.name: Mean NDVI (greenness)
members.source: MODIS MOD13Q1 NDVI (250 m), Google Earth Engine
members.method: Zonal mean greenness on the council polygon, 2001-2020 (scripts/compute-gee-eo.py)

members.name: Soil moisture
members.source: NASA-USDA SMAP 10 km surface soil moisture, Google Earth Engine

members.name: Extreme wet days (>50 mm)
members.method: Days with council-mean rainfall above 50 mm, per year, 2015-2024 (scripts/compute-council-climate.py)

members.name: Very-heavy days (>100 mm)
members.method: Days with council-mean rainfall above 100 mm, per year, 2015-2024 (scripts/compute-council-climate.py)

members.name: Slope susceptibility (mean)
members.source: SRTM 30 m elevation, Google Earth Engine
members.method: Mean terrain slope on the council polygon, degrees (scripts/compute-gee-eo2.py)

members.name: Triggering rainfall (max 1-day)
members.source: CHIRPS daily rainfall, Google Earth Engine

members.name: Extreme wind speed
members.source: ERA5-Land daily 10 m wind, Google Earth Engine
members.method: Period maximum of daily maximum wind speed, 2015-2023 (scripts/compute-gee-eo2.py)

members.name: Hot days (Tmax > 35C)
members.source: ERA5-Land daily maximum 2 m temperature, Google Earth Engine
members.method: Days per year with Tmax above 35 C, 2015-2023 (scripts/compute-gee-eo2.py)

members.name: SPEI-12 drought depth
members.source: CHIRPS v3 monthly rainfall and ERA5 2 m temperature
members.method: Mean magnitude of SPEI-12 during drought months on the council polygon, 1991-2024 (scripts/compute-council-drought-members.py)

members.name: Rainfall variability (CV)
members.method: Interannual coefficient of variation of annual rainfall on the council polygon, 1991-2024 (scripts/compute-council-drought-members.py)

members.name: Historical seismicity density
members.method: Events within 50 km of the council centroid, 1960-2024, scaled to events per 100 years (x 100/65; scripts/compute-council-earthquake.py)

members.name: Maximum felt intensity
members.method: Maximum felt intensity at the council centroid over the events of 1960-2024: max of 1.5 M - 1.5 log10(R + 15), a simple attenuation (scripts/compute-council-earthquake.py)

members.name: Refugees and asylum-seekers hosted
members.source: UNHCR Tanzania operational data 2024 (rounded camp and urban figures)
members.method: Refugees and asylum-seekers hosted in the district (Nyarugusu, Nduta, transit and urban caseloads), copied to its councils (data-source/displaced_refugees.csv)

members.name: Recorded flood impact events
members.source: Recorded flood events compiled from PMO-DMD, DesInventar, EM-DAT and press reports
members.method: Number of recorded flood events in the district, 2010-2024 (data-source/flood_events.csv), copied to its councils; the committees' validated event reports replace this file

members.name: Health facilities per 10,000 people
members.source: 2022 Population and Housing Census geodatabase (NBS/OCGS), facilities spatially joined to the 195 council polygons with the facility types filtered
members.method: Health facilities (dispensaries, health centres, hospitals) per 10,000 people of the council (2022 census; scripts/spatial-join-facilities-councils.py)

members.name: Schools per 10,000 people
members.source: 2022 Population and Housing Census geodatabase (NBS/OCGS), facilities spatially joined to the 195 council polygons with the facility types filtered
members.method: Schools (pre-primary to secondary) per 10,000 people of the council (2022 census; scripts/spatial-join-facilities-councils.py)

members.name: DRM arrangements in place (EPRP AA EOCC ERT RVCA)
members.source: PMO-DMD list of DRM arrangements (June 2026) and the DRR records approved through the Data portal
members.method: Count of the arrangements recorded for the council (EPRP, anticipatory action, EOCC, ERT, RVCA), 0 to 5, computed by the engine from the council's record (src/engine/risk/advanced.ts)
